source_basis.source_scope: received WEB Luke coordinate and text surface plus its direct internal canonical cross-reference metadata only
source_basis.editorial_metadata_guard: Headings, paragraphs, punctuation, red letters, footnotes, Strong-style numbers, cross-reference formatting, songs, and variants are evidence only.

coverage_contract.routing_principle: Prefer complete paired panels, scenes, songs with narrative frames, lists, controversy exchanges, parable clusters, discourse movements, journey episodes, trial sequences, passion episodes, tomb-road-appearance units, and exact competing routes.

second_temple_primary.classification: direct-period context eligible only with source-specific dating and provenance
second_temple_primary.guard: No external Second Temple primary source was read; future use may inform context but cannot dictate a seam, identity, fulfillment, theology, or history.

modern_second_temple_reconstruction.guard: Expose evidence chain and uncertainty and retain no seam authority.

early_rabbinic_reception.classification: reception or comparative evidence requiring source-specific dating, redaction, and transmission controls

later_rabbinic_reception.classification: reception only, never direct first-century context

parallel_policy.note: No Synoptic or Acts proposal, map, or parallel table was read.

variant_and_song_guard.guard: Every variant, song, blessing, oracle, prayer, witness, punctuation, heading, and received coordinate remains LOW evidence only. No witness, reading, speaker identity, authorship, doctrine, chronology, or canon is selected.

routing_principle: Use participant, setting, time, action, speech, question-answer, paired-panel, list, song-frame, journey, parable, refrain, and closure evidence. Rapid kai or egeneto chaining alone neither forces a split nor a merge. All decisions remain LOW and deferred.
